rules.name: Shadow and Fury
rules.description:
Units gain a keyword based on certian keywords they have
- **Talons**: **Infantry** units that do not have **Terminator**, **Jump Pack** gain this keyword
- **Falcons**: **Infnatry** units that do not qualifiy for the **Talons** keyword or **dreadnought** units
- **Hawks**: **Mounted** or **vehicles** with the **Fly** and **Flyer** keyword or **Monsters** with the **Fly** and **Jump Pack** keyword

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Models with this keyword can re-roll **wound** rolls of 1 in the turn the charge

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Models with this keyword gain **[Feel No Pain 6+]** when they make an **advance** or if they already have a **[Feel No Pain]** add 1 to the roll to a maximum of a 4+

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Models with this keyword gain **[Infiltrators]** keyword and have a **[Feel No Pain 6+]** against shooting attacks that are from more then 9" away.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your Command phase, you can select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army declares a charge while it is within 12" of that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Charge roll, but it must declare that enemy unit as a target of that charge (if possible).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
You can target this model’s unit with the Rapid Ingress and Heroic Intervention Stratagems for 0CP,
even if you have already used that Stratagem on a different unit this phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a unit, models  in this unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 12".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this model’s unit is not within Engagement Range of any enemy models, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

characteristics.name: Description

This model can make 6" pile-in and consolidation moves.
If this model does make a pile-in and/or a consolidation move this turn you can re-roll all **[Feel No Pain]** rolls of 1 against ranged attacks
